Offices
Find an office
Nineteen county offices serve Pickaway County residents. Each page lists contact details, hours where they apply, and the forms and services that office handles.
Elected officials and administration
Auditor Chief fiscal officer, property appraisal, payroll, and dog, kennel and vendor licences.
Commissioners The county's taxing, budgeting and purchasing authority.
Treasurer Real property and manufactured home tax collection, and county investments.
Recorder Permanent record of land conveyances and encumbrances.
Board of Elections Voter registration, ballots and election administration.
Prosecutor Felony prosecution and legal counsel to county offices and boards.
Coroner Contact details for the county coroner's office.
Courts and legal
Common Pleas The trial court of general jurisdiction, with local rules, filing information and jury service.
Juvenile & Probate Juvenile cases, estates, guardianships, adoptions and name changes.
Clerk of Courts Court records, court costs, and the Auto Title Division.
CASA Court Appointed Special Advocates for abused and neglected children.
Land, permits and infrastructure
Engineer County roads, bridges and drainage, with permits and easement forms you can complete online.
Building Department Building permits, contractor registration and inspections.
Development & Planning Subdivision regulations, land-use planning and economic development incentives.
Health, safety and community
Sheriff Law enforcement, court security, jail operations and service of papers.
Emergency Management Disaster preparedness, 911, radio communications and Nixle alerts.
Health Department Immunizations, food licensing, sewage and well permits, and vital statistics.
Dog Shelter Adoptions, dog licensing, lost and found dogs, and animal control.
Veterans' Assistance Benefits claims, emergency financial assistance and transportation to VA appointments.
